summary: Assess loan pools, tranche losses, and transaction protections through applied securitization analysis. Explore the advanced five-day course.
lede: Structured finance and securitization credit risk analysis assesses how asset-pool performance and transaction structures shape tranche losses. For advanced credit analysts, underwriters, and investors, the course supports reviews of securitized credit using pool- and transaction-level evidence. You will stratify loan pools, test default and recovery assumptions, calculate waterfall loss allocation, and evaluate credit enhancement and performance trends, with Basel securitization concepts and IFRS 9 considerations introduced for comparison.
audienceIntro: This advanced course suits professionals who assess, structure, invest in, or monitor securitized credit and need to defend conclusions at asset-pool and tranche level.
prerequisites: Prior experience in credit analysis, structured finance, securitization, fixed-income investing, or transaction risk review is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises use spreadsheet-based analysis.
